description: Minified JavaScript plugin for fjTimer, a timer and function queue utility.

methods.name: fjFunctionQueue
methods.description: Manages a queue of functions to be executed sequentially, with support for auto-start, onTick, onComplete callbacks.

methods.name: fjTimer
methods.description: Creates a timer that executes a callback function at specified intervals, with options for repeat, randomization, and completion callback.

methods.name: fjTimerEach
methods.description: Iterates over an array, executing a callback for each element, utilizing fjTimer for timing control.
